title: Portugal vs Spain: Which Should You Visit?
description: A data-backed comparison of Portugal and Spain based on Reddit discussions, real costs, weather data, and traveler preferences.

faqs.question: Is Portugal or Spain better for a first visit to Iberia?
faqs.answer: For a first visit, Spain offers more sheer variety — Barcelona, Madrid, Seville, Granada, San Sebastián, and the Balearic Islands all have distinct identities. faqs.question: Which is cheaper, Portugal or Spain?
faqs.answer: Portugal is consistently 15–25% cheaper than Spain. A mid-range restaurant meal costs €12–20/person in Lisbon vs €18–28 in Madrid or Barcelona. faqs.question: Is Portugal or Spain better for beaches?
faqs.answer: Spain wins on beach variety: the Mediterranean coast (Costa Brava, Costa del Sol) has warm, calm water; the Balearic Islands (Mallorca, Ibiza, Menorca) are world-class; and the Canary Islands offer year-round sunshine. faqs.question: What is the best city to visit in Portugal?
faqs.answer: Lisbon is the obvious answer for first-timers: the hilltop neighborhoods (Alfama, Bairro Alto, Mouraria), iconic yellow trams, Pastéis de Belém, and the Fado music tradition make it one of Europe's most captivating capitals. faqs.question: What is the best city to visit in Spain?
faqs.answer: Barcelona is Spain's most internationally celebrated city: Gaudí's Sagrada Família and Park Güell, Las Ramblas, Gothic Quarter, incredible food, and beach all in one place. faqs.question: When is the best time to visit Portugal and Spain?
faqs.answer: For Portugal: April–June and September–October are ideal. Lisbon in May is glorious — sunny, 22°C, green hills, affordable prices. faqs.answer: Very easy — they share the Iberian Peninsula. Lisbon to Madrid is 5.5 hours by bus or car, or 45 minutes by flight. Porto to Madrid is 6 hours by car or 1 hour by flight. faqs.answer: Spanish is significantly easier for English speakers to pronounce — it's highly phonetic and each letter has a consistent sound.
